CONVERSATION.NAME: Claire thinks she still has a claim on Justin.
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP: Show her that you're powerful and good for him, and may be all the medicine he needs.

CARD.NAME: He wants to see me again
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin was totally into me, and wants to see me again.

CARD.NAME: High Self Esteem
CARD.DESCRIPTION: (You're comfortable with who you are. Your confidence makes Claire more unsure of herself.)
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: I know how to take care of people
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I know how to take care of people, and make them feel great about themselves. You just drag everyone down.

CARD.NAME: I make him laugh.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I make him laugh. Laughter is the best medicine.

CARD.NAME: If you really cared about Justin
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you really cared about Justin, you wouldn't stand in the way of his happiness with me.

CARD.NAME: Justin wasn't thinking about you
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin sure wasn't thinking about your "special bond" when he hooked up with Stephanie!

CARD.NAME: Not impressed.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Your yipping at me is about as impressive as that chihuahua you carry around.

CARD.NAME: People like me
CARD.DESCRIPTION: People like me. They just fear you - but that's going to change.

CARD.NAME: What's so special about you?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I have yet to see what's special about you - other than in the short-bus way.

CARD.NAME: You are obviously unhinged
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You are obviously unhinged. Justin doesn't need that in his life right now.

CARD.NAME: You're living in the past.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're living in the past. You've changed, and so has he.

CARD.NAME: You're still hung up on Justin
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're clearly still hung up on Justin. Why don't you just admit that?

CARD.NAME: Biting Words
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Claire's words shake your confidence.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: Everyone does what I say
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Everyone in this town does what I tell them to, and Justin is no exception.

CARD.NAME: Everyone thinks you're a major skank
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You may have just gotten to town but we all smelled you coming. Everyone thinks you're a major skank.

CARD.NAME: He just feels sorry for you
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin probably just feels sorry for you because you don't know anyone and thinks you're pathetic.

CARD.NAME: He'll always love me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin will always love me. Even if hell froze over and he went out with you, he'd be thinking of me.

CARD.NAME: He's a flirt
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin loves to flirt, but he's totally laughing at you behind your back.

CARD.NAME: If Justin wins, you're history
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If Justin becomes a famous skateboarding star, he'll want someone hot by his side, and you're so NOT.

CARD.NAME: No guy would ever pick you over me
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If I'm around, no guy would ever pick you over me.

CARD.NAME: Stephanie knows what she did wrong
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stephanie knows what she did wrong, and she's paying the price. Just like anyone will if they try to get in my way.

CARD.NAME: Superior Attitude
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Claire's big house and fancy clothes make her look down on the little people You get less confident when you try to humiliate Claire.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my opponent's cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: Watch yourself
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm not sure you know who you're dealing with. You do not want to make me angry.

CARD.NAME: We have a bond
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin and I have a bond that you could NEVER understand.

CARD.NAME: Why am I even bothering with you?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Why am I even bothering talking to you? You're just a little nothing.

CARD.NAME: You're so common
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin could never love you. You're just so...common.
